---
name: Submit a verification
about: Report a reproducible check on one declaration or mathematical step
title: "Verification · "
---

Open the [atlas](https://yiweiivy.github.io/riemann-hypothesis-atlas/), select a node, and record your check. Use its GitHub submission action to prepare the scoped report. If you copied the report, replace this text with the complete Markdown, including its JSON block.

Include the exact statement or node, the version and source, your method and result, and the evidence group or run ID. Link a public run log, paper and page, or code with a commit. State any assumptions, scope limits, or shared inputs. Public issue authors receive credit for their submitted report.

[Example dependency check](https://github.com/YiweiIvy/riemann-hypothesis-atlas/blob/main/docs/verification.md) · [Contribution guide](https://github.com/YiweiIvy/riemann-hypothesis-atlas/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
